name: ZCH_DEDUP_LINK_MEMBERS
description: This table stores link members information. It is an intersection table between link and member. All member join/departure information is captured and stored in this table

columns.name: DEDUP_LINK_MEMBER_ID
columns.description: Primary Key

columns.name: DEDUP_LINK_TYPE
columns.description: Type of links in this set.

columns.name: CREATED_BY_PROCESS_ID
columns.description: Process instance which created this link member

columns.name: CREATED_BY_PROCESS_TYPE
columns.description: Type of process which created this link member

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY_PROCESS_ID
columns.description: Process instance which last updated this link member

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY_PROCESS_TYPE
columns.description: Type of process which last updated this link member

columns.name: REVIEWED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if this link member was reviewed by a user

columns.name: OBJECT_CODE
columns.description: Object whose record is a member of this link set

columns.name: OBJECT_USAGES
columns.description: Usages of the object whose record is a member of this link set

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the member record in the registry DB.

columns.name: DEDUP_LINK_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to ZCH_LINKS

columns.name: DATA_MGMT_MEMBER_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to ZCH_MEMBERS

columns.name: MASTER_FLAG
columns.description: Master of the member

columns.name: RESTORE_FLAG
columns.description: The past member record which can be restored.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the end of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: DATA_MGMT_SNAPSHOT_ID
columns.description: Snapshot of attribute values of the member of the data set when it was added to this link set

columns.name: DATA_SET_UUID
columns.description: Data set which contains this link member

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
